title: Daughter, mother 82: can't move left arm and leg, slid off the chair

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: 1200 Fell Street, apartment 5. It's my mom, she's 82.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She suddenly can't move her left arm or her left leg. She just slid off her chair onto the floor.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Is she awake and talking to you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: She's awake, she's talking to me, but she can't get up.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Can she stand if you help her?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, she can't stand up at all, she just falls over to the left.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was she last seen completely normal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: About an hour ago. She was fine, she was reading in her chair.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Does she take any blood thinners?

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Don't try to lift her, keep her comfortable.
